why: Multiple post-snapshot papers settle special cases of the Fröberg conjecture itself: quintics/septics in four variables (arXiv 2608.24797), the second non-trivial degree for degree d>2 forms and degree up to 2d-1 for sufficiently many variables (Boij, Dannetun, Lundqvist, arXiv 2605.03872, submitted 2026-05). These are cases of the stated Hilbert-series conjecture, not a different problem.

found.title: Independence of generic forms and the Fröberg conjecture
found.note: Preprint proving the conjecture in the second non-trivial degree for d>2 and up to degree 2d-1 for large enough variable counts; not read.

found.title: Fröberg's Conjecture for Quintics and Septics in Four Variables
